title: Extremal Mean-Variance Functionals over Wasserstein Balls: Applications to Risk Sharing
abstract: arXiv:2609.23571v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We characterize the worst- and best-case values of a mean-variance functional over a 2-Wasserstein ball. Using quantile representations and the geometry of attainable means and standard deviations, we reduce both infinite-dimensional problems to scalar equations and construct the extremal laws as location-scale transformations of the reference distribution. Their values depend on the reference law only through its first two moments. We then derive dual representations and formulate proportional risk sharing under heterogeneous beliefs as a finite-dimensional optimization problem. Under homogeneous beliefs, we show that the classical proportional allocation remains optimal for every ambiguity radius and $\alpha$-maxmin weight. Finally, we study a coupled distortion-variance functional and characterize its worst-case quantile through a convex-envelope construction, allowing the extremal law to change in shape as well as location and scale.

translated_title: Wasserstein球上的极值均值-方差泛函：在风险分担中的应用
translated_abstract: 我们刻画了均值-方差泛函在2-Wasserstein球上的最坏情形与最优情形取值。利用分位数表示以及可达均值与标准差的几何结构，我们将这两个无穷维问题约化为标量方程，并将极值分布构造为参考分布的位置-尺度变换；其取值仅通过参考分布的前两阶矩而依赖于参考分布。随后我们导出了对偶表示，并将异质信念下的比例风险分担问题表述为有限维优化问题。在同质信念下，我们证明经典的比例分配对于任意模糊半径和α-maxmin权重仍然保持最优。最后，我们研究了一类耦合的扭曲-方差泛函，并通过凸包构造刻画其最坏情形分位数，使得极值分布不仅在位置和尺度上、还可以在形状上发生变化。
tldr: 本文刻画了2-Wasserstein球上均值-方差泛函的最坏与最优情形值，证明极值分布是参考分布的位置-尺度变换且仅依赖其前两阶矩，并应用于风险分担问题，证明同质信念下经典比例分配对任意模糊半径始终最优。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the worst- and best-case values of mean-variance functionals over 2-Wasserstein balls, showing the extremal laws are location-scale transformations depending only on the first two moments of the reference distribution, and applies these results to risk sharing, proving that classical proportional allocation remains optimal under homogeneous beliefs for any ambiguity radius.
